|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The December 2003 interim text and January 2004 slip impose the loss whenever a Jedi is lost. The remastered text narrows that trigger to a Jedi lost by the opponent. Both keep the opposing battle loss, immunity reduction, permanent-weapon restriction and draw-phase upkeep.
